question: Kapag ang isang tao ay nahihirapan, mas mahalaga bang may mabilis tayong sagot—o marunong muna tayong makinig nang totoo?

verses.text: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
